title: Scott products and sobriety of countable meet-continuous dcpos
summary: We study Scott-product compatibility and sobriety for countable meet-continuous directed-complete partial orders (dcpos). We construct a countable meet-continuous dcpo $\mathcal R$ whose Scott space is well-filtered but not sober, although the Scott topology on every finite power is the product of the factor Scott topologies. The ideals of $\mathcal R$ admit a unique finite-parameter description.
